dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new Iranian safeguards decision, qualifying enrichment-production threshold, weaponization order, detonation or NPT withdrawal appeared. IAEA public news and press pages again returned HTTP 403; reachable UN feeds added no Iranian nuclear threshold. Raw 49; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: MarineTraffic counted 29 verified Strait of Hormuz crossings from 24-26 July (21 outbound, eight inbound), confirming severe restriction but not zero traffic or physical closure. The direct U.S.-Iran strike pause held into 28 July, and Iran's foreign minister discussed strait security with Saudi and Omani counterparts. No signed arrangement or verified traffic normalization appeared. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: AFP reports a U.S. State Department official set the next Israel-Lebanon session for 4-6 August in Rome, with work on the framework, pilot zones and border issues. Lebanon's NNA also reported Israeli bombing and demolition operations in Majdal Zoun, Mansouri and Bint Jbeil on the morning of 28 July. The concrete channel reactivates canonical diplomacy_active while field violations continue; probability holds. Raw 87; coupled 97

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: The rolling-day Google/Bing review and NATO pages produced regional air-defence commentary, not verified Turkish combat entry, unusual force concentration, a qualifying long-range weapons event or official atomic-weapons threshold. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Search operations after suspected Pakistani drone movement near Samba and Rajouri remain the latest operational fact. No post-scan attribution, exchange of fire, interstate strike or unusual force concentration was independently verified. Raw 15; coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Rolling-day results repeated disputed claims about Pakistani strikes and added a militant attack inside Pakistan, not a fresh independently verified state-on-state event. No new sustained border clash, corroborated Afghan strategic strike or unusual force movement appeared after the prior scan. Raw 46; coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: BBC confirms Ukraine's 25 July Caspian drone strike targeted the Iranian cargo vessel Anna near the Volga mouth. Ukraine says it carried military components; Iran and Russia describe civilian cargo, and Iran reports one sailor killed and several injured. This directly links the Ukraine and Iran wars but does not add a configured nuclear, force-buildup or NATO-entry threshold. Raw 99; coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: NATO's official news and advisory pages showed no Article 4/5 consultation, collective force decision or announced retaliation after Romania's expulsion of a Russian embassy employee. Moscow's threatened response remains unspecified. Raw 58; coupled 68

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Rolling-day Taiwan coverage continued to show routine-to-elevated PLA air and maritime pressure, but no blockade, amphibious concentration, expanded live-fire operation or direct China-Taiwan clash was verified. Exact China-Taiwan market prices edged up but remained sanity-only. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: A 28 July Asia Times analysis describes strategic returns from North Korea's missile supply pipeline to Russia; it does not report a new shipment, troop movement, launcher relocation, operational firing or prohibited detonation. South Korean monitoring still has not confirmed the circulated fresh troop-deployment claim. Raw 18; coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Late rewrites repeat the SAF claim that it controls the Khartoum-El Obeid route. Direct Radio Dabanga reporting still says local sources dispute full reopening, fighting continues and the RSF retains Reihad El Nuba; no independent control confirmation or casualty figure from the new El Obeid drone attack emerged. Raw 94; coupled 94

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: UN News says planned fast-tracking and legalization of West Bank outposts is a flagrant violation of international law amid escalating settler violence; later reporting described raids and settler attacks, including mosque fires. This materially sustains the extreme lane but does not establish a new mass mobilization, implemented withdrawal or durable truce. Raw 92; coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: Rolling-day indexing produced no new South Sudan-Abyei clash, verified large force movement, transition breakdown or UNISFA posture change. Raw 19; coupled 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
